reason: A web interface skin plugin that configures static image or muted looping video wallpapers, translucent panels, and an in-app control panel.

summaries.zh: 为 dsh Web 界面设置静态图片或静音循环视频壁纸，并提供半透明面板与悬浮控制面板。
summaries.en: Customize the dsh web interface with a static image or muted looping video wallpaper, translucent panels, and a floating control panel.

capabilities: Changes the web interface background using a configured local image or video file
Adds a translucent floating control panel for wallpaper settings and preview
Provides plugin web routes for media, configuration, and client delivery
